product.name: Fasadställningar (Facade Scaffolding)
product.description: Temporary scaffolding structures erected on building exteriors to provide access and support during construction or maintenance.

product.name: Bygghissar (Construction Hoists)
product.description: Mechanical lifts used to transport workers and materials vertically between floors on construction sites.

product.name: Väderskydd (Weather Protection)
product.description: Temporary coverings that shield construction or scaffolding areas from adverse weather conditions to protect work progress and materials.

product.name: Industriella Ställningar (Industrial Scaffolding)
product.description: Custom scaffolding solutions designed for industrial environments with space constraints and specific technical requirements.

product.name: Specialställningar (Special Scaffolding)
product.description: Custom-built scaffolding structures for unique project requirements such as walkways, emergency stairs, or suspended scaffolds.

product.name: KMA & Konstruktion (Quality, Environment, Safety & Design)
product.description: Project management services focusing on quality, environmental, and safety compliance, including scaffold design using CAD and 3D modeling.
